"""Prepare the one additive JSON evidence child without touching frozen content."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = ROOT / "archive-repo"
PREFIX = "Docs/Design/StructureReferences/2026-11-25"
OUT = REPO / PREFIX
DEST = OUT / "delivery-status"
CONTENT_COMMIT = "1b3b72b46800f43783f4deb625da5a509c658741"
CONTENT_TREE = "ea7a18080b1bd081710624ffc93e80d397728a03"
CONTENT_MANIFEST_SHA256 = "fa2f08a709128765b24d8b37cb37f953fb66d23eef207f4057675dca2fdd4db9"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("archive_tools", ROOT / "archive-tools.py")
helpers = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(helpers)

IMPORTS = [
    ("root-package-verification.json", "root-package-verification.json"),
    ("root-package-verification-initial.json", "history/root-package-verification-initial.json"),
    ("root-package-reopen.json", "history/root-package-reopen.json"),
    ("root-context-repair-verification.json", "history/root-context-repair-verification.json"),
    ("root-remote-content-verification.json", "root-remote-content-verification.json"),
    ("reviews/critic-package-audit.json", "independent-package-audit.json"),
    ("reviews/critic-package-audit-r1.json", "history/independent-package-audit-r1.json"),
    ("critic-package-audit-data.json", "independent-audit/package-data.json"),
    ("reviews/critic-remote-content-verification.json", "independent-remote-content-verification.json"),
    ("critic-content-ref-fresh-readback.json", "independent-readback/content-ref.json"),
    ("critic-content-commit-fresh-readback.json", "independent-readback/content-commit.json"),
    ("critic-content-tree-fresh-readback.json", "independent-readback/content-tree.json"),
    ("archive-content-publication.json", "content-publication-receipt.json"),
    ("archive-remote-content-verification.json", "archive-remote-content-verification.json"),
    ("archive-content-remote-readback.json", "archive-content-remote-readback.json"),
    ("archive-expected-paths.json", "content-manifest.json"),
    ("archive-before-context-fix-expected-paths.json", "history/prior-content-manifest.json"),
    ("archive-context-input-repair.json", "history/context-input-repair.json"),
    ("archive-large-text-blob-receipts.json", "content-large-text-blob-receipts.json"),
    ("archive-created-tree.json", "content-tree-creation-receipt.json"),
]
ENVELOPES = [
    ("critic-package-audit.py", "independent-audit/package-audit-source.json"),
    ("verify_package_root.py", "root-package-audit-source.json"),
    ("archive-prepare-delivery.py", "delivery-preparation-source.json"),
]

def metrics(data):
    return helpers.metrics(data)

def read_json(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_bytes())

def write_exact(path, data):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if path.exists():
        assert path.read_bytes() == data, "Refusing changed delivery artifact: " + str(path)
    else:
        path.write_bytes(data)

def json_bytes(data):
    return (json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n").encode("utf-8")

def main():
    manifest_data = (ROOT / "archive-expected-paths.json").read_bytes()
    assert metrics(manifest_data)["sha256"] == CONTENT_MANIFEST_SHA256
    content_manifest = json.loads(manifest_data)
    assert content_manifest["candidate_tree"] == CONTENT_TREE
    readback = read_json(ROOT / "archive-content-remote-readback.json")
    assert readback["ref"]["object"]["sha"] == CONTENT_COMMIT
    assert readback["commit"]["sha"] == CONTENT_COMMIT
    assert readback["commit"]["tree"]["sha"] == CONTENT_TREE
    assert readback["tree"]["sha"] == CONTENT_TREE
    assert readback["tree"]["truncated"] is False
    prior = [x for x in readback["tree"]["tree"] if x["type"] != "tree"]
    assert len(prior) == 4439
    assert helpers.git_tree_identity(prior) == CONTENT_TREE
    prior_by_path = {x["path"]: x for x in prior}
    assert len(content_manifest["files"]) == 295
    for entry in content_manifest["files"]:
        data = (REPO / entry["path"]).read_bytes()
        actual = metrics(data)
        assert all(actual[k] == entry[k] for k in ("sha256", "git_blob_sha", "bytes")), entry["path"]
        remote = prior_by_path[entry["path"]]
        assert remote["sha"] == entry["git_blob_sha"] and remote["mode"] == entry["mode"]

    records = []
    expected_local = set()
    for source_rel, dest_rel in IMPORTS:
        source = ROOT / source_rel
        data = source.read_bytes()
        json.loads(data.decode("utf-8"))
        destination = DEST / dest_rel
        write_exact(destination, data)
        expected_local.add(destination)
        records.append({"storage": "exact_json_copy", "original_locator": str(source),
                        "original_task_relative_locator": source_rel,
                        "archive_path": destination.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(), **metrics(data)})

    for source_rel, dest_rel in ENVELOPES:
        source = ROOT / source_rel
        data = source.read_bytes()
        source_metrics = metrics(data)
        text = data.decode("utf-8")
        assert text.encode("utf-8") == data
        envelope = {"schema_version": 1, "artifact_kind": "exact_source_utf8_envelope",
                    "original_locator": str(source), "original_filename": source.name,
                    "original_task_relative_locator": source_rel,
                    **source_metrics, "encoding": "utf-8", "content_utf8": text}
        destination = DEST / dest_rel
        envelope_data = json_bytes(envelope)
        write_exact(destination, envelope_data)
        assert read_json(destination)["content_utf8"].encode("utf-8") == data
        expected_local.add(destination)
        records.append({"storage": "exact_utf8_embedded_in_json", "original_locator": str(source),
                        "original_task_relative_locator": source_rel,
                        "archive_path": destination.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
                        "json_pointer": "/content_utf8", "encoding": "utf-8",
                        "embedded_source": source_metrics, "envelope": metrics(envelope_data)})

    existing_records = []
    for source_rel in ["critic-base-commit-fresh-readback.json", "critic-base-tree-fresh-readback.json", "archive-binary-blob-receipts.json"]:
        source = ROOT / source_rel
        data = source.read_bytes()
        identity = metrics(data)
        matches = [row for row in content_manifest["files"] if row["sha256"] == identity["sha256"]]
        assert matches, "Previously committed source is missing: " + source_rel
        for row in matches:
            assert (REPO / row["path"]).read_bytes() == data
        existing_records.append({"storage": "unchanged_existing_content", "original_locator": str(source),
                                 "original_task_relative_locator": source_rel,
                                 **identity, "content_commit": CONTENT_COMMIT,
                                 "archive_paths": [row["path"] for row in matches]})

    summary = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "status": "CONTENT_VERIFIED_DELIVERY_RECEIPTS_READY_FOR_SINGLE_FINAL_REF_CHECK",
        "repository": "ksolo21-web/HAVENLINE", "branch": "art/structures-2026-11-25",
        "batch_date": "2026-11-25", "batch_timezone": "America/New_York",
        "verified_content_commit": CONTENT_COMMIT, "verified_content_tree": CONTENT_TREE,
        "content_manifest_sha256": CONTENT_MANIFEST_SHA256,
        "baseline_commit": "b80c61f13ba31bb0940792dd47976a8e2878dbf5",
        "baseline_tree": "598ca77bd0635e418e7eced4db6384658f9687d4",
        "preserved_baseline_leaves": 4144, "verified_content_additions": 295,
        "verified_content_leaves": 4439,
        "accepted_static_scope": {"assets": ["fence", "gates", "customer service counter"],
            "selected_sheets": 9, "rotation_views": 24, "generated_original_pngs": 17,
            "retained_rejected_attempts": 8, "exact_invoked_prompts": 17,
            "ordered_actual_generation_input_occurrences": 49, "qa_image_files": 68,
            "qa_provenance_and_observation_records": 24},
        "acceptance": {"independent_visual_score_each_selected_sheet": 9.7,
            "independent_visual_all_mandatory_checks_passed": True,
            "root_package_score": 10, "independent_package_score": 10,
            "root_remote_content_score": 10, "independent_remote_content_score": 10,
            "target_score": 10, "pass_rule": "Strictly above 9.0 with every mandatory check passed"},
        "native_output_dimensions": {"fence_and_gates": [1254, 1254], "customer_counter": [1536, 1024]},
        "claim_boundary": "Completed static raster reference sheets and exact archive custody. Native mesh, rig, animation, collision, physics and runtime behavior are not tested or approved by this batch. The separate requirement for two distinct camp openings remains a runtime/layout requirement.",
        "history_policy": "Earlier pending and failed states are retained unchanged as historic evidence. The missing prior character style guide review input was added unchanged and resolved; root and independent critic then passed the repaired exact 295-file candidate.",
        "delivery_child_policy": {"maximum_delivery_children": 1, "only_additions_below": PREFIX + "/delivery-status/",
            "file_type": "UTF-8 JSON", "frozen_content_changes_allowed": [],
            "sole_parent": CONTENT_COMMIT, "expected_ref_before_update": CONTENT_COMMIT,
            "force_update": False,
            "final_ref_check": "After this single child is published, compare the fresh ref, commit and untruncated tree with the exact child additions manifest and all 4439 preserved content leaves. That final readback is reported without a recursive proof commit."},
        "exact_imports": records,
        "cited_inputs_already_in_verified_content": existing_records,
        "gallery": {"archive_path": PREFIX + "/GALLERY.md", "immutable_content_url": "https://github.com/ksolo21-web/HAVENLINE/blob/" + CONTENT_COMMIT + "/" + PREFIX + "/GALLERY.md"}
    }
    summary_path = DEST / "summary.json"
    write_exact(summary_path, json_bytes(summary))
    expected_local.add(summary_path)
    assert {x for x in DEST.rglob("*") if x.is_file()} == expected_local

    additions = []
    elements = []
    for path in sorted(expected_local):
        repo_path = path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix()
        assert repo_path.startswith(PREFIX + "/delivery-status/") and path.suffix == ".json"
        assert repo_path not in prior_by_path
        data = path.read_bytes()
        text = data.decode("utf-8")
        json.loads(text)
        row = {"path": repo_path, "mode": "100644", "type": "blob", **metrics(data)}
        additions.append(row)
        elements.append({"path": repo_path, "mode": "100644", "type": "blob", "content": text})
    candidate_entries = prior + [{"path": x["path"], "mode": x["mode"], "type": x["type"], "sha": x["git_blob_sha"]} for x in additions]
    candidate_tree = helpers.git_tree_identity(candidate_entries)
    manifest = {"schema_version": 1, "repository": "ksolo21-web/HAVENLINE", "branch": "art/structures-2026-11-25",
        "parent_commit": CONTENT_COMMIT, "parent_tree": CONTENT_TREE,
        "expected_head_lease": CONTENT_COMMIT, "candidate_tree": candidate_tree,
        "allowed_prefix": PREFIX + "/delivery-status/", "allowed_preexisting_changes": [],
        "preserved_content_leaves": 4439, "delivery_additions": len(additions),
        "expected_final_leaves": len(candidate_entries), "files": additions}
    (ROOT / "archive-final-expected-paths.json").write_bytes(json_bytes(manifest))
    (ROOT / "archive-final-tree-request.json").write_bytes(json_bytes({"repository_full_name": "ksolo21-web/HAVENLINE", "base_tree_sha": CONTENT_TREE, "tree_elements": elements}))
    check = {"status": "PASS_EXACT_ADDITIVE_JSON_CHILD", "score": 10,
        "reviewer": "archive owner bounded child verification", "candidate_tree": candidate_tree,
        "preserved_content_leaves": 4439, "unchanged_local_frozen_package_files": 295,
        "exact_json_imports": len(IMPORTS), "exact_source_envelopes": len(ENVELOPES),
        "delivery_additions": len(additions), "all_additions_json_only_under_delivery_status": True,
        "all_added_paths_absent_from_parent": True, "all_imports_and_envelopes_byte_verified": True,
        "expected_final_leaves": len(candidate_entries), "issues": []}
    (ROOT / "archive-final-local-verification.json").write_bytes(json_bytes(check))
    print(json.dumps({**check, "manifest_sha256": metrics(json_bytes(manifest))["sha256"]}, indent=2))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
